account.welcome.subject: Welcome to BIND
booking.approved.body:
Hi {creator},

{business} has confirmed your booking for {item}{quand_phrase}.

Open the app to see your pickup code. Show it at the counter.
booking.approved.subject: {business} confirmed your booking
booking.cancelledByBusiness.body:
Hi {creator},

{business} has had to cancel your booking for {item}{quand_phrase}.

What they said: {motif}

This is on their side, not yours: your reliability score is untouched. The slot is free again if they reopen it.
booking.cancelledByBusiness.subject: {business} had to cancel your booking
booking.declined.body:
Hi {creator},

{business} was not able to take your booking for {item}{quand_phrase}.

What they said: {motif}

Nothing changes on your side — your tiers and your reliability are untouched. Other salons are open to you right now.
booking.declined.subject: {business} could not take your booking
booking.toReview.body: Someone booked {item}. Open BIND to accept or decline.
booking.toReview.subject: A booking is waiting for you
collaboration.approved.body: Nice work. {business} accepted your post for {item}.
collaboration.approved.subject: Your post was approved
collaboration.opened.body:
Hi {creator},

You have redeemed {item} at {business}. Now publish a {format} and send us the proof before {deadline}.

{requirements}
Open the app to submit your proof.
collaboration.opened.subject: Your collaboration with {business} has started
collaboration.reminder.body:
Hi {creator},

Your proof for {item} at {business} is due on {deadline}. Stories disappear after 24 hours, so send it while your post is still online.
collaboration.reminder.subject: Your proof for {business} is due soon
collaboration.requirements.geotag: Add the business location to your post.
collaboration.resubmit.body:
Hi {creator},

{business} could not accept your proof for {item}:

{reason}

You have until {deadline} to send a corrected one.
collaboration.resubmit.subject: One more step for {business}
collaboration.unfulfilled.body:
Hi {creator},

The deadline for {item} at {business} passed without an accepted proof. This affects your reliability score.
collaboration.unfulfilled.subject: Your collaboration with {business} was not honoured
handover.invitation.body:
Hi,

We prepared your BIND page for {business} — address, hours and services are already in.

Open the link below to review it, create your account and put it online. Nothing is visible to creators until you do.

{url}

The link works once and expires on {expiration}.
handover.invitation.subject: {business} is ready on BIND
subscription.ended.body:
Hi,

The trial period for {business} ended, so your offers no longer appear in the creator feed.

Nothing has been deleted: your catalogue, hours and history are untouched, and **bookings already made will still be honoured**. Subscribe from the app to come back.
subscription.ended.subject: {business} is no longer showing to creators
subscription.graceEnding.body:
Hi,

{business} has been live on BIND without a subscription so far. That period ends on {echeance}.

After that your offers stop showing to creators. Nothing is deleted — your catalogue, hours and history stay, and **bookings already made will still be honoured**. Subscribe from the app and you are back in the feed straight away.
subscription.graceEnding.subject: Your BIND trial ends on {echeance}
support.accessOpened.body:
Hi,

Someone from BIND support opened your {business} account to work on it.

Reason given: {motif}

The access is time-limited and closes on its own. You can see every past access in your settings — we tell you each time, every time.
support.accessOpened.subject: BIND support opened your {business} account
